title: Louis B NDE 924
content: I was in a car accident, where my ribs were broken just before I died. As I slipped from my body, I was standing all of a sudden in an area filled with red and green flowers. Off a little way was a building and a man standing there. He told me to go to the window. I was amazed and confused about where I was; and wondering how I got there from just being in a car wreck a minute ago. I went to the window and they told me it's not my time and to go back. I went back to where I was standing when I first got there. The next thing I knew I was in the car accident again, back in pain once again.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death Car accident.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Felt like I was beamed there sort of like on 'Star Trek', no comedy intended.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Just the man calling me to go to the window.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The man that called me to the window, he was standing near a small building.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I saw the beautiful flowers, red and green, that were all over.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will They told me to go back, but I wasn't quite sure how, so I just went back to where I was originally standing, and boom, I was in the car again, hurting.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The worst part was not knowing what it was all about, the best was that I still seemed alive.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: No Shocked, some didn't believe it.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It just proved to me that beyond a shadow of a doubt, there is life after death, I was dead for approximately five minutes.
